training_state.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

notes: Official test set used for ReID checkpoint selection and association-threshold calibration; not held-out evaluation.
No GT supplied to tracker prediction; same original RGB detections and same fine-tuned embeddings.
Deep OC-SORT tunes IoU acceptance gate, NOT a nonexistent cosine appearance gate. Embedding weight .75 stays fixed.

ImprAsso tunes active combined-cost match_thresh. appearance_thresh is unused in this implementation. lambda=.05, proximity=.1, second_match=.19 stay fixed; internal low-score cost scaling match_thresh/second_match_thresh follows native code.
This compares joint ReID adaptation + threshold calibration against original untuned baseline; it does not isolate a pure ReID-only gain.
No claims that grid maximum is global optimum. No unrecorded adaptive expansion.
